row.notes: (graph,out u32): fetches a ref via [graph+8] vt+8, lock-decrements its count +0x18; resource = [[ref+0x28]+8]; initial D3D12 state = res+0x78 or from usage flags res+0x20 (0x40->8, 0x400->0x400, 0x1000->0xac3, 2->0x42, 1->0x41, 4->1, else 0x8c0/0xac3); out = Render_Gfx2_HandleMap_FindOrAdd(graph,out,res,state), or 0xffffffff when absent. Callers 0x140101940, Ne_CustomisationDecalRenderer_BakePasses. Better name: Ne_RenderGraph_ImportResourceWithInitialState (bound record keeps its name).
